Mourning Dove, Cogewea, the Half-Blood, edited by Lucullus Virgil McWhorter.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/mourning-dove/cogewea-the-half-blood

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Mourning Dove, the author, died 1936.
- Lucullus Virgil McWhorter, the annotator, editor and writer of the foreword, died 1944.

First publication of the text used: 1927 (SE colophon: 'Cogewea, the Half-Blood was published in 1927 by Mourning Dove.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1927, before 1931, and the edition's rights statement below says it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths (last death: 1944), so the text is public domain in each of them. The facts point to none of France, Spain, Mexico, Colombia, Russia or the USSR.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: Cogewea, the Half-Blood was published in 1927 by Mourning Dove.
- Wikidata Q11937719 (Mourning Dove), P570 = 1936-08-08
- Wikidata Q6698131 (Lucullus Virgil McWhorter), P570 = 1944-10-10
